# LinkOps AI repository instructions

Build changes as small, reviewable increments. Preserve the separation between the
FastAPI URL-shortener product plane and the LangGraph engineering control plane.
Prefer deterministic validation and typed contracts over free-form agent behavior.
Do not put confidential assignment content, secrets, raw IP addresses, or arbitrary
shell execution into the product. Add tests and update architecture documentation
when APIs, persistence, workflow routing, approvals, or deployment behavior changes.
